title: Financial Controller - LATAM
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description


Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.


Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

*Please note that this is a temporary position to cover a maternity leave.*


Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred


Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Senior Consultant – Global Transaction Banking (GTB)
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).


If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ; graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.


Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.
  • MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead strategic GTB transformation projects for top-tier financial institutions.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with exposure to high-impact banking initiatives.
  • Continuous learning, certifications, and professional development plans .
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • Flexible work model (Hybrid – São Paulo).


CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR - R$ 800,00
  • A collaborative work environment, internal events, and global mobility opportunities.


Learn more about us: nfq.es | LinkedIn NFQ

Ready to lead GTB transformation and make an impact in corporate banking? Apply now!

title: Senior Advisor, Country Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.


The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.


Key Responsibilities


1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively


2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.


3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.


4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.


5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.


6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.


7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).


Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!


About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.


Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.



Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient


Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.


A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.


More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Analista fiscal Jr
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Analista Fiscal, você irá:


  • Conhecimento sobre fato gerador de impostos indiretos: ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS COFINS;
  • Análise de documentos fiscais: NFe, CTe NFSe;
  • Vivência em apuração de impostos;
  • Conhecimento sobre direito a crédito de impostos;
  • Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias: SPED ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, DIRBI
  • Conhecimento em registro de notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Conhecimento sobre regras de carta de correção;
  • Experiência com sistema integrado, SAP ECC e Tax One será diferencial.


Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:


  • Formação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência comprovada na área fiscal;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Office (Work, PowerPoint e Excel);


Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:


  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Refeição no Local
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site: .

About the job

Plaza Premium Group is the global leader in airport lounges and hospitality! With over 25 years of experience, we are redefining travel by creating seamless, world-class airport experiences in over 350 locations worldwide. From award-winning lounges to premium airport services, we take pride in delivering exceptional comfort, convenience, and care to travelers. As a dynamic and fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities, a diverse and inclusive workplace, and the chance to be part of a team that’s shaping the future of travel. If you're passionate about hospitality and thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment, we’d love to have you on board!


Position Summary:


The Manager of Third-Party Lounges & Partnerships (3PL) is responsible for managing Plaza Premium Group’s network of third-party lounges in Latin America. This role ensures that external lounge partners deliver on service excellence, operational standards, and commercial expectations. The candidate will work closely with internal teams and external partners to expand, maintain, and optimize the third-party lounge portfolio across key airport locations.


Key Responsibilities:


Partnership & Network Management

  • Act as the primary liaison for third-party lounge (3PL) partners, overseeing daily relationship management and issue resolution
  • Support onboarding of new partner lounges, including due diligence, contract finalization, and systems integration.
  • Monitor service quality, brand alignment, and operational performance across the 3PL network.


Commercial Oversight

  • Support commercial negotiations, pricing agreements, and renewals with lounge operators.
  • Collaborate with the finance and legal teams to ensure contracts reflect service commitments and protect company interests.
  • Track and report on revenue, utilization rates, and partner performance KPIs.


Service Excellence & Compliance

  • Conduct regular audits, site visits (where applicable), and partner evaluations to ensure compliance with agreed service levels and guest experience standards.
  • Provide feedback and guidance to partners on service improvements, customer complaints, and operational efficiency.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with product, tech, and marketing teams to ensure accurate lounge listings, guest communications, and booking functionality.
  • Align with customer experience teams on issue escalation processes, service feedback, and brand consistency.


Market Development & Expansion

  • Identify new third-party lounge opportunities in underserved markets or strategic locations.
  • Support the expansion of the 3PL network to meet guest demand and strengthen the company's airport hospitality footprint.


Qualifications & Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, Business, Travel Management, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, vendor & account management, or hospitality operations.
  • Trilingual, English and Portuguese and Spanish
  • Strong understanding of the airport lounge or travel services landscape.
  • Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in data analysis and reporting tools; able to derive insights from partner performance data.
  • Willingness to travel for partner visits, audits, or market evaluations.

title: Senior Specialist Operations
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Specialist Operations to join our Supply Chain team, with strong analytical and project management skills, solid experience in operational planning, exception handling, and continuous improvement. This professional will be responsible for ensuring that workforce, equipment, and infrastructure are strategically dimensioned and continuously optimized to meet operational volumes with quality, agility, and cost efficiency. The role also involves leading data-driven initiatives, conducting time and motion studies, and driving process improvements through accurate analysis and collaboration with multiple departments.


Responsibilities

The Senior Specialist Operations will develop and monitor short-, medium-, and long-term capacity and workforce planning for in-house operations, analyze and allocate resources based on demand and performance, and ensure that operational KPIs such as efficiency, SLA, absenteeism, and UPH are continuously tracked and improved. This person will lead exception handling routines, identify root causes, and implement preventive actions to stabilize processes.

The role includes managing and executing continuous improvement projects focused on productivity, efficiency, and cost reduction, performing time and motion analysis to establish standard times, eliminate waste, and improve process flow. The professional will generate and interpret analytical reports and dashboards using BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI, ensuring data accuracy and visibility for decision-making.

Collaboration with global and local teams is essential to align planning strategies, forecast volumes, and validate supplier capacity. The position also requires preparation of performance reports and the ability to present insights and recommendations to senior management.


Requirements

Proven experience in Operational Planning, Exception Handling, and Process Improvement within logistics or e-commerce operations. Strong knowledge of S&OP and S&OE processes, fluent English for daily interaction with international stakeholders, advanced analytical and communication skills, and solid experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other data analysis tools.


Nice to Have

Experience with WMS systems and warehouse operations, advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies, experience managing projects using structured frameworks and KPIs, familiarity with process mapping and automation tools, and prior experience conducting time and motion studies or labor standardization initiatives.

title: Especialista Tributário|Financeiro
description:

title: Pessoa Mantenedora II
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

4. Colaborar com outros departamentos e equipes para coordenar ações de manutenção e compartilhar informações relevantes.

5. Participar de treinamentos e programas de desenvolvimento profissional para aprimorar habilidades técnicas e manter-se atualizado com as melhores práticas.

6. Operar e inspecionar equipamentos e sistemas conforme instruções de trabalho, monitorar e registrar parâmetros de operação localmente ou via sistemas supervisórios (entendendo lógicas de funcionamento e conceitos básicos de mecânicas e elétricas), realizar registros precisos e comunicação de eventos, ocorrências e desvios.

Realizar atividades de Operação e Manutenção utilizando software para cumprimento, abertura e fechamento de OS's, reportar problemas e desvios, avaliar estado geral da planta como organização, limpeza e conservação, realizar liberação de atividades próprias e de terceiros (APR, PT, Regrham, manobras de bloqueio, estado de EPI's), receber serviços, NF's, relatórios e materiais

São Paulo- SP-Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Analista de Processos – Pleno
description:
Analista de Processos Pleno

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você será responsável por identificar e implementar oportunidades de melhoria tecnológica e operacional que aumentem a eficiência dos processos internos. Seu papel envolve mapear fluxos, propor soluções técnicas e acompanhar a efetividade das implementações, garantindo que as mudanças tragam ganhos reais e sustentáveis para a operação.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Identificar, por meio de métodos Lean e análise de processos, oportunidades de melhoria e automação;
  • Mapear o processo AS IS e propor o TO BE, apoiando o refinamento das estórias em parceria com o Analista Funcional;
  • Revisar procedimentos e políticas, elaborando e aplicando treinamentos para as equipes envolvidas nas mudanças;
  • Atuar na gestão de mudanças, garantindo que a operação se adapte às novas soluções sem impactos negativos;
  • Acompanhar a eficácia das soluções implementadas por meio de análises quantitativas e qualitativas, propondo ajustes quando necessário;
  • Promover alinhamento entre as áreas de tecnologia e negócio para garantir que as melhorias estejam em conformidade com as metas estratégicas da companhia.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência com melhoria de processos, eficiência operacional ou gestão da mudança em ambientes corporativos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias Lean e ferramentas de análise de processos;
  • Capacidade de traduzir oportunidades de negócio em soluções técnicas ou operacionais viáveis;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de conduzir treinamentos e alinhamentos entre áreas;
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a resultados e atento a detalhes.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência em transformação digital ou implantação de soluções tecnológicas;
  • Dominar ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, Excel avançado, etc.) para acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
  • Já tiver atuado em empresas de grande porte ou em projetos de melhoria contínua de alta complexidade;
  • Possuir certificações ou formações complementares em Lean Six Sigma, Gestão de Processos (BPM) ou Gestão da Mudança (ADKAR, PROSCI);
  • Demonstrar iniciativa e capacidade de facilitar a colaboração entre times técnicos e operacionais.



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo



Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.



Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

description:
Missão do cargo:

Desenvolver e sustentar funcionalidades de software , que agreguem valor ao produto, garantindo a satisfação do cliente dentro do segmento de atuação.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com baixo nível de supervisão e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias back-end envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a fundo a arquitetura back-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de média através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
  • Cria framework se necessário para o desenvolvimento de suas soluções.


Formação:

Superior completo em tecnologia e afins (desejável).


Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Lógica de Programação;
  • Linguagem de programação para back-end Java – nível avançado;
  • Fundamentos em frameworks de back-end *Spring) – nível avançado;
  • Fundamento em testes unitários - nível avançado;
  • Banco de Dados – nível avançado;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software – desejável nível intermediário;
  • Arquitetura de Software (exemplo: cliente-servidor, web, outros) – nível intermediário.

title: Supervisor de TAX Indiretos
description:
Sobre a área


A Consultoria Tributária é a ponte entre a complexidade das leis fiscais e as decisões estratégicas das empresas. Atuamos com foco em inteligência fiscal, identificando oportunidades de economia, mitigações de riscos e garantindo o compliance com a legislação. É uma área dinâmica, que combina análise técnica, visão de negócio e proximidade com o cliente — ideal para quem gosta de desafios, atualização constante e impacto direto nos resultados das organizações.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenar projetos de revisão fiscal e apuração de tributos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS), assegurando o correto cumprimento das obrigações tributárias.
  • Identificar riscos fiscais e oportunidades de recuperação de créditos e eficiência tributária, com foco consultivo e estratégico.
  • Realizar a interpretação e análise de documentos fiscais, contábeis e societários, aplicando conhecimento técnico às operações tributárias indiretas.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com clareza e objetividade, evidenciando impactos financeiros e recomendações práticas.
  • Apoiar clientes na compreensão e adequação à legislação, traduzindo pontos técnicos em linguagem acessível.
  • Fazer a ponte entre clientes, sócios e demais áreas da empresa (contábil, legal, financeira), promovendo um trabalho colaborativo.
  • Supervisionar as entregas da equipe (analistas e consultores juniores), promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e garantindo a qualidade dos trabalhos.
  • Participar de propostas comerciais, reuniões com clientes e contribuir para o fortalecimento da área de TAX Indiretos.


Requisitos:


  • Formação superior completa em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em apuração, revisão e planejamento de tributos indiretos.
  • Domínio das legislações de ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS, e dos regimes tributários: Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional.
  • Vivência em revisão de compliance fiscal, levantamento de créditos tributários e regimes especiais é um diferencial.
  • Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para lidar com diferentes interlocutores.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado é desejável.


Competências comportamentais:


  • Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Proatividade e perfil hands-on.
  • Liderança e foco em desenvolvimento de equipe.
  • Organização e foco em resultados.


Benefícios


  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida

title: Analista GIS Sênior (ArcGIS) (Presencial Goiânia/GO)
description:
Vaga de atuação presencial no Cliente, localizado em Goiânia/GO.


Descrição da vaga

O profissional deverá suportar tecnicamente a equipe técnica do cliente, executando as atividades relacionadas a configuração, manutenção e melhor uso da plataforma ArcGIS, apresentadas a seguir:


• Instalação e configuração de softwares nativos plataforma ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro e Apps);

• Atualização de versão e configuração de softwares plataforma ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro e Apps);

• Administração dos dados armazenados nos Ambientes ArcGIS Enterprise e Online;

• Demonstrações de utilização da plataforma ArcGIS Enterprise, incluindo Apps; • prontas para uso (Survey123, Dashboard, etc.);

• Mentoring e acompanhamento dos usuários da plataforma ArcGIS;

• Explicação sobre a utilização de extensões;

• Publicação e gestão dos serviços de mapas no ArcGIS Enterprise ou ArcGIS Online;

• Publicação de geoprocessing no ArcGIS Enterprise;


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Prestar apoio no planejamento executivo dos projetos na aquisição, tratamento e gerenciamento de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos, realizando o levantamento de informações técnicas e analisando os insumos necessários com base em aspectos qualitativos e quantitativos;
  • Utilizar a edição de dados em geodatabase e criar modelos simples de geoprocessamento, criar, editar e explorar dados geográficos no ArcGIS Pro, criar layout simples de mapas e compartilhar mapas;
  • Utilizar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS, como ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos, aplicando os principais componentes e funcionalidades da Plataforma ArcGIS (Server, Mobile, Desktop, Online e extensões) e ter habilidade de identificar onde ela se aplica;
  • Utilizar ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Realizar e aplicar modelagem de um geodatabase utilizando versionamento e elementos de rede e modelos complexos de geoprocessamento;
  • Aplicar a plataforma ArcGIS para realizar análise espaciais e ser capaz de automatizar processos;
  • Criar e aplicar elementos cartográficos dinâmicos e criar layout de mapas complexos;
  • Aplicar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS e ter habilidades avançadas para aplicar as ferramentas na visualização, criação, gerenciamento e análise de dados geográficos;
  • Aplicar o uso de geotecnologia nas diversas áreas de negócios verticais de atuação da Imagem;
  • Propor a escala de trabalho adequada para a solução de diferentes problemas geográficos;
  • Resolver problemas de distorções e compreender características específicas de dados geográficos, cuja origem esteja relacionada com a fonte;
  • Ter domínio das funcionalidades do ArcGIS e propor melhorias na utilização das ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos e auxiliar a equipe;
  • Propor melhorias no uso das ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Domínio das principais extensões do ArcGIS e propor utilizações inovadoras na utilização das principais extensões;
  • Criar e estruturar novas metodologias de execução de serviços de geoprocessamento, estimativas e controle de qualidade conforme as características específicas a serem executadas.



Formação:

  • Graduado em Geografia, Cartografia, Engenharia Ambiental ou outras Ciências da Terra.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimentos avançados em GIS;
  • Conhecimentos das soluções e produtos ESRI;
  • Compreensão referente a origem e conceitos básicos das tecnologias e metodologias para aquisição de dados geográficos;
  • Conhecimento dos principais padrões de metadados existentes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Técnico para leitura;

  • Conhecimento em Sensoriamento Remoto, Geodésia, Cartografia, Análise Espacial, SIG’s e GIS Web.

title: Supplier Quality/Operations Project Manager
description:
Company description

ÅF Automotive is part of the AFRY group, which is one of the most popular employers in Sweden, we have more than 17 thousand consultants around the world. We have been operating in Brazil since 2013 in the area of Automotive Engineering at several automakers in Brazil, and clients in Sweden and the USA. Our headquarters are located in São Bernardo do Campo/SP and the branch is in Curitiba/PR. We care about creating the future, come be part of this story!

New brand. ÅF and Pöyry come together as AFRY. We are 17,000 devoted experts, brave enough to stand up for what we believe in #Making Future


Job Description:

We are currently looking for experienced and proactive professionals to support our client in California. The roles will focus on Production Launch , Supplier Quality , and Module Leadership activities, playing a key part in the development and ramp-up of vehicle program.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Launch Engineering: Lead and coordinate production launch activities, ensuring readiness across suppliers and manufacturing sites. Monitor timelines, solve issues, and support ramp-up plans.
  • Supplier Quality: Collaborate closely with suppliers to ensure component quality and readiness for launch. Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to maintain quality targets.
  • Module/Program Leadership: Oversee assigned modules or systems, acting as the main interface between cross-functional teams. Ensure alignment with vehicle development milestones, timing, and technical requirements.
  • Quality Integration: Possess a strong understanding of quality frameworks and processes. Ensure that quality considerations are seamlessly integrated into the supply chain, involving early engagement with supplier quality teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Drive activities to successful conclusions. Anticipate upcoming issues and risks, providing innovative solutions. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement and implement operational enhancements.
  • Communication and Reporting: Foster clear and effective communication between internal teams, suppliers, and stakeholders. Keep all relevant documentation up-to-date and maintain a high standard of reporting accuracy.
  • Bilingual Proficiency: Fluent English proficiency is required. Fluency in Spanish is a significant advantage, enabling seamless communication with the local team and suppliers.


Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Fluent English and Spanish
  • Availability for business trips and occasional on-site support in the EUA
  • Driver's license required
  • Must be a Brazilian citizen

title: Learning Expert
description:
Job Summary : The Learning Expert is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L&D initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Training Program Application

  • Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats.
  • Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment.
  • Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records.
  • Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.

2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation

  • Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires.
  • Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
  • Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.

3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

  • Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps.
  • Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.g., completion rates, performance improvement).
  • Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.

4. Content & Training Material Development

  • Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning.
  • Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations).
  • Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.

5. Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels.
  • Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning.
  • Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with department heads to align training with business goals.
  • Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.).
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.

7. Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Technical Skills (Preferred/Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with LMS platforms and e-learning tools and knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel) and video training software.
  • Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management abilities, Engaging facilitator with excellent presentation and communication skills. Analytical mindset to assess training effectiveness and adapt programs.

Você será responsável por liderar e garantir a execução dos processos de vendas do setor de calçados, assegurando a excelência no atendimento ao cliente conforme nosso roteiro de atendimento.


Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Coordenar, treinar e orientar a equipe de vendas, garantindo o padrão de atendimento, fornecendo feedbacks constantes e promovendo a melhoria contínua no desempenho e nos resultados.
  • Fazer a gestão do estoque de calçados, analisando mix, volume de produtos e estratégias de vendas.
  • Garantir a execução da estratégia de Visual Merchandising do paredão de calçados, considerando categorias, precificação e marcas.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de vendas e atendimento, identificando oportunidades e propondo melhorias para o crescimento do negócio.
  • Realizar diariamente reuniões de alinhamento com o time, acompanhando desempenho frente às metas diárias e direcionando estratégias comerciais e de atendimento.
  • Gerir processos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros), assegurando conformidade com normas internas.
  • Atuar como líder próximo e inspirador, promovendo desenvolvimento, engajamento e retenção do time.


Para jogar bonito, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes e processos de vendas.
  • Boa comunicação, foco na experiência do cliente e capacidade de priorizar o roteiro de atendimento.
  • Experiência anterior em varejo têxtil e/ou calçados. (Desejável)


A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.


Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.


Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Desenvolvimento de Negócios Globais - Especialistas em Varejo
description:
Se você já liderou no varejo - na loja ou na sede - queremos falar com você.


Sim, somos uma empresa de tecnologia.


Não, você não precisa ter experiência em tecnologia.


Na STOREE.AI, criamos uma plataforma que permite que os gerentes se dupliquem em uma versão com inteligência artificial - um gêmeo digital capaz de liderar equipes, atribuir tarefas, acompanhar KPIs e treinar colaboradores.


Já somos utilizados por mais de 100 redes de lojas.


A tecnologia funciona.


Agora precisamos de pessoas que entendem de varejo para ajudar outros a entender como fazer isso funcionar para eles.


Por que a experiência em varejo é importante:


Nossa plataforma é ampla - ela pode fazer muita coisa.


Mas o que funciona bem para uma rede pode ser completamente diferente para outra.


Uma rede de cosméticos precisa de ferramentas diferentes das de um supermercado.


Um diretor de VM enxerga valor em funcionalidades diferentes das que importam para um head de RH ou de operações.


É por isso que não queremos vendedores.


Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:


  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos


Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.


O que você vai realmente fazer:


  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo


Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.


Para quem é essa oportunidade:


  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira


Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.


É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria


Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.


Acesse nosso site:

description:

Nesse cenário, estamos construindo novas frentes usando tecnologia avançada, automação inteligente e soluções digitais que vão impulsionar ainda mais o nosso crescimento e transformar a forma como entregamos valor ao nosso cliente/negócio.


Buscamos pessoas colaborativas, criativas e comprometidas em desenvolver soluções que façam a diferença. Se você quer atuar em um ambiente onde a transformação acontece de verdade, com autonomia, colaboração e impacto real, vem conversar com a gente!


Objetivo:


Estruturar projetos estratégicos, oferecer apoio consultivo em projetos de transformação digital e implementar a fase inicial (MVP ou entrega prioritária) utilizando tecnologias avançadas como ChatBot's, Inteligência Artificial, RPA, entre outras.

  • Analisar dados, gerar insights e apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Planejar a transição do projeto para o time de Projetos (Evolução).


O que você precisa saber?


  • Formação Superior completa em Tecnologia (Ciência da Computação, Eng. de Software, ADS, Sistemas de Informação e afins);
  • Experiência na área de negócios/funcional em projetos envolvendo inovação, transformação digital e/ou implementação de software;
  • Levantamento e Gestão de Requisitos: domínio de técnicas para extrair, documentar e gerenciar requisitos de negócio, funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Modelagem de Processos: experiência com BPMN para mapear, analisar e redesenhar fluxos;
  • Documentação: elaboração de artefatos como User Stories, Casos de Uso, Especificações Funcionais e Regras de Negócio.


Diferencial:


  • Experiência anterior no segmento financeiro;
  • Design Thinking e UX: ideação e foco na jornada do usuário em novas soluções.
  • IA e Machine Learning: compreensão de conceitos, especialmente NLP, aplicados a chatbots e assistentes virtuais.
  • Plataformas de Chatbot e URA: Conhecimento em Dialogflow, Watson, Bot Framework, Rasa etc. Noções sobre intenções, entidades, fluxos e integrações.
  • Cursos de IA, certificações em Chatbots e Engenharia de Prompt aplicada a LLMs.


Habilidades esperadas:


  • Habilidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e resolver problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação e argumentação;
  • Organização, pois vai atuar com detalhamento e requisitos de processos;
  • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas com base nas necessidades de negócios e objetivos estratégicos;


Benefícios que Valorizam Você:


No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.


  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados: Mediante resultados do banco, conforme convenção coletiva.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status; nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity; strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week
  • Consistent schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Fully remote: Work from anywhere
  • Direct collaboration with an entrepreneurial leader
  • Exposure to multiple industries: Construction, lead generation, nonprofit, real estate
  • Ground-floor opportunity: Help build foundational systems for scaling ventures
  • Learning environment: Strong focus on AI implementation and automation
Company Culture & Values


Culture in one line: We are problem solvers—systems over heroics—and the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.


Core Values:

  • Integrity
  • Growth Minded
  • In Service to Others
  • Provide Solutions
Onboarding & Support


There is currently no formal onboarding program—this will be part of the early partnership. You'll collaboratively identify the tools and support structures needed to achieve great outcomes. This is an opportunity to help shape the operational foundation from the ground up.


Application Process


Please send the following to (operations+ ) :

  1. Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.pdf)
  2. Cover Letter addressing:
  • How you meet the required skills and experience
  • Specific examples of systems or SOPs you've built
  • Your experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, automation tools)
  • A time you anticipated a leader's needs and proactively solved a problem
  • How you've closed loops and driven projects to completion
  • Why you're interested in supporting multiple ventures simultaneously
  1. AI Competency Example: Share a specific example of how you've used AI tools to automate a workflow, solve a problem, or improve efficiency
  2. Email Subject: Systems Over Heroics

Timeline: We aim to fill this position within 2–3 weeks.

Well-structured and thoughtful applications demonstrating critical thinking and systems-first approach will stand out. If you have questions about the role, feel free to include them in your message.
